articles.summary: Liquid biopsy is a fascinating and quickly evolving technology. Since the early 2000s, these tests have become increasingly complex, capable of gathering data on tens of thousands of genes across a patient’s DNA footprint at a time. The post What Does the Future Hold for Liquid Biopsy Technology appeared first on Personalis .
articles.title: What Does the Future Hold for Liquid Biopsy Technology
